stable_sample.visual: Woman in a pale blue/purple hoodie, dark left side with danmaku, silver microphone, curtain/cabinet background. The local arrangement resembles the earlier Bilibili/AcFun January 12 danmaku samples, but no identical danmaku line or distinctive gesture was matched.

samples.test_hypothesis: A candidate position was tested by adding the Bilibili non-danmaku P1 metadata duration (3115 seconds) to a Bilibili P2 sample near 600 seconds. This is an exploratory comparison only, not a fixed offset.

stable_sample.visual: A different long white text/letter page was visible. The text was not transcribed. It did not match the shorter Bilibili P2 letter-page sample around 600 seconds.
Woman in a pink top holding a small spoon and eating while seated in front of a silver microphone; dark left side with danmaku. This appearance differs from the January 12 hoodie sample.

assessment: The January 12 official replay P1 has a local programme/danmaku scene similar in broad layout to earlier Bilibili and AcFun January 12 danmaku P1 samples, without an exact line/action match. A second exploratory point based on a 3115-second metadata duration did not match the shorter Bilibili P2 letter sample; this does not establish a cut, offset, or missing duration. The January 3 official P1 sample shows a different local appearance, but clothing cannot independently establish recording date or exclude other kinds of content elsewhere in that replay. These records support limited comparisons only and do not resolve whether the Bilibili date/title groups or AcFun version correspond to one or multiple mother sessions.
limitations: Only three stable points were checked across the two official replay pages; initial pending seeks were excluded.
No audio was listened to, no full page/session was watched, and no exact dialogue or frame match was established.
The 3115-second duration was not treated as a valid fixed time offset; no cut length, missing segment, or non-overlap conclusion follows.
Calendar listing, replay page title/publication time, interface appearance, and garments do not independently authenticate mother-session dates.
